comment: CCSDS telemetry, concatenated: Reed-Solomon outer code (each transfer frame `depth` interleaved RS(255,223) codewords, randomized, behind the 32-bit attached sync marker) and the rate 1/2, K=7 convolutional inner code over the whole stream, ASM included (G2 inverted). BPSK. Which symbol pairs make a branch is found by re-encoding (sync puncture); the code is transparent, so a 180 degree carrier ambiguity inverts the decoded bits and the delimiter puts it right by the marker's sense

rs.comment: the Reed-Solomon code: rs/ccsds_255_223_dual (the standard's dual basis) or rs/ccsds_255_223 (conventional)

requires.comment: any symbol rate: given, or measured

message.comment: a transfer frame: the RS data of its depth codewords
